specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_exclusions: Advanced mesh repair/export supports nằm ở 10 After.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Bounding Box And Center Object” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M03: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Bounding Box And Center Object”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

technical_decisions: Đọc source module owner trước khi sửa. Dữ liệu hiển thị/chọn không được thay đổi BRep khi chỉ có ý định đo hoặc kiểm tra.
Undo/Redo và save/reopen phải bảo toàn document state, errors phải hữu hình và có test cụ thể.
Check object validity, naked edges và invalid topology trên true BRep; report panel không có quyền tự sửa geometry.

positive.setup: Create the geometry and select the inputs required by: bounding and centering analysis actions
positive.expected: Closed box has no naked edge and IsValid=true; intentionally open face has naked border and user-visible report without mutating BRep.

negative.setup: Corrupted/degenerate edge topology: report invalid edges with ID; refuse automated repair unless command explicitly requests it.
negative.expected: Explicit domain error; document IDs, BRep cache, selection and undo journal unchanged

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.positive_assertions: world-space bbox and geometric center calculated from exact transform

m03_luna_execution_contract.manual_references_precision: Many references are inherited parent-L2 page ranges, not command-exact citations
invariants: OCCT BRep/Geom is truth for exact geometry; mesh/tessellation only derived
No partial document commit on failure or cancellation
Stable object and subobject identity or explicit broken-reference error
No fabricated test receipts, measured values, or manual review
m03_luna_execution_contract.agent_handoff: Read this L3 first, then precisely one L4 child. Do not start until prerequisite gates and real source available.

focused_test_handoff.parent_golden_positive_oracle: world-space bbox and geometric center calculated from exact transform
focused_test_handoff.independent_domain_example_proposed_not_: command invoked with valid selection and chosen options, and with no selection/locked layer/unavailable backend
domain_specific_assertions_to_select_whe: command ID resolves to one backend handler or explicit disabled fallback
parameter and document units are preserved when passed from UI to service
enabled action triggers one transaction and refreshes correct scene
Cancel/Undo reverts to prior state; no duplicate BRep implementation in UI
negative_cases_to_select_when_applicable: no valid selection or locked layer must not mutate scene
backend not implemented => disabled with visible reason, never deceptive success

proposed_tolerance_policy_require_local_.interaction_tolerance: backend-owned; do not invent pixel/geometry tolerance
